extracted.name: Banana Pancakes
extracted.description: Banana pancakes have captured the hearts of many, solidifying their position as a beloved breakfast favorite that seamlessly combines deliciousness with healthfulness. The appeal lies in the natural sweetness and moist texture imparted by ripe bananas, making them a delightful treat for all ages. These pancakes have emerged as a top choice for busy mornings, providing a quick, easy-to-make, and satisfying meal. With their heartiness and nutritious profile, they offer a wholesome start to the day. Whether enjoyed plain or topped with berries and a drizzle of honey, banana pancakes bring a smile to faces while fueling the body with nourishment and energy.
instruction_lines: In a mixing bowl, whisk together the flour, sugar, baking powder, baking soda, and salt.
In a separate bowl, combine the mashed banana, milk, egg, and melted butter. Stir well to combine.
Pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and gently mix until just combined. Be careful not to overmix; some lumps are fine.
Heat a non-stick skillet or griddle over medium heat. Grease it lightly with butter or cooking spray.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet for each pancake. Cook until bubbles form on the surface, then flip and cook for another 1-2 minutes until golden brown.
Repeat with the remaining batter, adjusting the heat if necessary to prevent burning.
Serve the banana pancakes warm, drizzled with honey. Optionally, garnish with sliced bananas on top for extra flavor and presentation.
Enjoy your homemade Banana Pancakes with Honey! Enjoy!!!
